project.name: fine-tuning-studio
project.description: Local-first UI for fine-tuning and exporting AI models.

nodes.name: artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Creates an integrity manifest for a job's exported artifacts using SHA-256 file hashes.

nodes.name: file_sha256
nodes.summary: Streams a file into SHA-256 and returns its hexadecimal digest.

nodes.name: write_artifact_manifest
nodes.summary: Atomically writes paths, sizes, and checksums for all files in an artifact directory.

nodes.name: evals.py
nodes.summary: Defines evaluation reports, score comparison, and isolated Inspect AI benchmark execution.

nodes.name: EvaluationManifest
nodes.summary: Describes the model, backend, tasks, limit, and creation time of an evaluation report.

nodes.name: write_evaluation_report
nodes.summary: Writes evaluation scores as JSON, CSV, and escaped HTML reports.

nodes.name: compare_reports
nodes.summary: Aligns two to four score reports by task for comparison.

nodes.name: inspect_command
nodes.summary: Validates requested Inspect AI tasks and builds the benchmark command line.

nodes.name: run_inspect
nodes.summary: Runs Inspect AI with a one-day timeout and writes its combined log output.

nodes.name: lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Safely cancels app-owned training workers, escalates shutdown when needed, and schedules clean application exit.

nodes.name: ShutdownReport
nodes.summary: Reports requested jobs, stopped processes, interrupted jobs, and shutdown errors.

nodes.name: _process_is_running
nodes.summary: Checks whether a process exists and is not a zombie.

nodes.name: _registered_worker
nodes.summary: Verifies that a process belongs to the app through ancestry or an expected worker command.

nodes.name: _terminate_tree
nodes.summary: Terminates a process tree, then kills survivors after a grace period.

nodes.name: stop_application_processes
nodes.summary: Cancels active jobs, verifies worker ownership, stops app descendants, and returns a structured shutdown outcome.

nodes.name: schedule_clean_exit
nodes.summary: Schedules a daemon timer that exits the application after shutdown completes.

nodes.name: resources.py
nodes.summary: Calculates whether full fine-tuning has enough free accelerator memory and disk capacity to proceed.

nodes.name: FullTrainingGate
nodes.summary: Represents a full-training resource decision and the reasons it may be denied.

nodes.name: full_training_gate
nodes.summary: Estimates full-training VRAM and disk needs and returns an allow-or-block decision.

nodes.name: gpu_memory.py
nodes.summary: Inspects NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPU memory use and safely reclaims application-managed resources.

nodes.name: GpuDeviceMemory
nodes.summary: Immutable GPU memory device record.

nodes.name: GpuProcess
nodes.summary: Immutable GPU process record with safety metadata.

nodes.name: GpuMemoryReport
nodes.summary: Groups detected devices, processes, and warnings.

nodes.name: GpuCleanupResult
nodes.summary: Captures before-and-after GPU cleanup results.

nodes.name: OllamaMemoryClient
nodes.summary: Protocol for listing and unloading Ollama models during cleanup.

nodes.name: inspect_gpu_memory
nodes.summary: Builds a vendor-neutral GPU memory and process report with protected-process labels.

nodes.name: process_protection_reason
nodes.summary: Explains why a GPU process cannot be terminated.

nodes.name: release_reclaimable_memory
nodes.summary: Clears supported allocator caches and unloads running Ollama models.

nodes.name: terminate_gpu_process
nodes.summary: Safely terminates an eligible GPU process after identity checks.

nodes.name: _clear_torch_caches
nodes.summary: Clears initialized CUDA, ROCm, and Intel XPU allocator caches.

nodes.name: _inspect_nvidia
nodes.summary: Queries nvidia-smi for devices and compute processes.

nodes.name: _inspect_amd
nodes.summary: Queries amd-smi JSON endpoints for VRAM and processes.

nodes.name: _inspect_intel
nodes.summary: Queries xpu-smi JSON process information.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs a GPU utility command with bounded timeout and safe failure.

nodes.name: hub_references.py
nodes.summary: Validates Hugging Face IDs and URLs, estimates downloads, and performs cache-aware repository downloads.

nodes.name: HubDownloadPlan
nodes.summary: Immutable Hub download estimate and revision record.

nodes.name: normalize_hub_reference
nodes.summary: Normalizes a Hugging Face repository ID or safe HTTPS repository URL.

nodes.name: plan_hub_download
nodes.summary: Dry-runs a Hub download and checks local cache disk capacity.

nodes.name: download_hub_repository
nodes.summary: Downloads a planned Hub model or dataset snapshot.

nodes.name: ollama.py
nodes.summary: Small local HTTP client for listing, inspecting, unloading, and chatting with Ollama models.

nodes.name: OllamaError
nodes.summary: Application error for Ollama communication failures.

nodes.name: OllamaModel
nodes.summary: Metadata for an installed Ollama model.

nodes.name: OllamaModelDetails
nodes.summary: Detailed Ollama model capability metadata.

nodes.name: OllamaRunningModel
nodes.summary: Runtime VRAM and context data for a loaded Ollama model.

nodes.name: OllamaClient
nodes.summary: Validates a local Ollama origin and calls its model and chat APIs.

nodes.name: _normalize_host
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a credential-free Ollama HTTP origin.

nodes.name: system_info.py
nodes.summary: Detects operating-system, CPU, GPU, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and Ollama capabilities for runtime selection.

nodes.name: GPUInfo
nodes.summary: Immutable detected GPU adapter record.

nodes.name: MachineReport
nodes.summary: Serializable machine capability report used throughout the application.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs a system inspection command with a bounded timeout.

nodes.name: _nvidia_gpus
nodes.summary: Discovers NVIDIA devices and VRAM through nvidia-smi.

nodes.name: _windows_display_adapters
nodes.summary: Discovers non-NVIDIA Windows display adapters through CIM.

nodes.name: _linux_display_adapters
nodes.summary: Discovers non-NVIDIA Linux display adapters through lspci.

nodes.name: _torch_runtime
nodes.summary: Reports PyTorch and CUDA, ROCm, and XPU availability.

nodes.name: _ollama_status
nodes.summary: Checks whether Ollama is reachable and lists installed models.

nodes.name: scan_machine
nodes.summary: Assembles a cross-platform machine, package, and integration report.

nodes.name: qlora_capability
nodes.summary: Explains whether the stable NVIDIA QLoRA path is ready.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Implements the command-line interface for launching the local Streamlit app, checking the installation, and managing backups.

nodes.name: doctor
nodes.summary: Collects storage integrity, interrupted-job, and machine diagnostics for command-line reporting.

nodes.name: _doctor_text
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable summary of the diagnostic result.

nodes.name: run_app
nodes.summary: Launches Streamlit with loopback networking and port 8503 defaults.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI subcommands and dispatches application, diagnostics, backup, restore, and version operations.

nodes.name: diagnostics.py
nodes.summary: Builds redacted ZIP diagnostic bundles containing system, storage, job status, and recent worker logs.

nodes.name: redact
nodes.summary: Replaces token, password, secret, and authorization values in diagnostic text.

nodes.name: build_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Packages redacted system details, storage state, job counts, and bounded recent logs into a support archive.

nodes.name: storage.py
nodes.summary: Provides SQLite schema migration, backup, restore, and integrity-check services for local Studio state.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Opens the SQLite database with WAL and foreign-key settings, applying migrations as needed.

nodes.name: _schema_version
nodes.summary: Reads the applied schema version while safely handling absent or unreadable migration metadata.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Creates and applies ordered SQLite migrations through the current schema version.

nodes.name: backup
nodes.summary: Creates a timestamped database and manifest backup with SHA-256 manifest hashes.

nodes.name: integrity_check
nodes.summary: Runs SQLite quick_check and returns its status for diagnostics.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Creates a safety backup, restores the SQLite database, and copies saved job manifests.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions continuous-integration workflow that tests the project on Windows and Linux across supported Python versions, then runs linting, type checking, builds, and dependency auditing.
nodes.languageNotes: The workflow uses a matrix strategy to exercise the same uv-based checks across operating systems and Python versions.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions release workflow triggered by version tags that validates the package version, runs tests, builds distribution artifacts, creates an SBOM and checksums, attests artifacts, and drafts a GitHub release.
nodes.languageNotes: The workflow uses GitHub OIDC attestation and pinned action commits to support reproducible release provenance.

nodes.summary: Defines community participation standards, reporting guidance, and enforcement expectations based on Contributor Covenant 2.1.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Explains local-first contribution expectations, development setup, validation checks, and pull-request requirements.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States supported versions, private vulnerability reporting, and local execution, credential, process, and shutdown security boundaries.

nodes.name: launch.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that checks for uv and starts the packaged Fine-Tuning Studio command.

nodes.name: launch.sh
nodes.summary: Linux shell launcher that checks for uv and starts the packaged Fine-Tuning Studio command.

nodes.name: configuration.md
nodes.summary: Documents the supported user environment variables for Hugging Face, Ollama, and local application storage, including Windows and Linux setup examples.

nodes.summary: Configures Dependabot to propose dependency updates for the project.

nodes.name: domain.py
nodes.summary: Core domain model for Fine-Tuning Studio: job status enum, multi-source DatasetSpec (schema v5), model/training/eval/export specs, RunManifest serialization, and pre-launch validation including PPO/ORPO/SimPO and OFT/QOFT constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with schema-versioned from_dict that migrates legacy single-dataset manifests into DatasetSpec.sources.

nodes.name: JobStatus
nodes.summary: StrEnum of job lifecycle stages from queued through completed, cancelled, failed, and interrupted.

nodes.name: DatasetSourceSpec
nodes.summary: One dataset source (hub or local) with split, format, column mapping, and chat-template settings for multi-dataset jobs.

nodes.name: DatasetSpec
nodes.summary: Dataset collection with a list of DatasetSourceSpec sources plus validation fraction and seed for train/test split.

nodes.name: ModelSpec
nodes.summary: Base model reference (hub or local) with revision and trust_remote_code acknowledgment flags.

nodes.name: TrainingSpec
nodes.summary: Training hyperparameters covering SFT and preference objectives (DPO/ORPO/SimPO/PPO/GRPO), LoRA/OFT/QOFT/full methods, distributed strategy, and PPO reward-model settings.

nodes.name: ProvenanceSpec
nodes.summary: Run provenance: dataset fingerprint, model revision, package versions, and recipe/runtime version strings.

nodes.name: EvaluationSpec
nodes.summary: Before/after training evaluation flags, optional benchmark list, and benchmark sample limit.

nodes.name: ExportSpec
nodes.summary: Export options for adapter, merged model, Hub upload, and Ollama import.

nodes.name: RunManifest
nodes.summary: Top-level job manifest (schema_version 5) composing dataset, model, training, evaluation, export, and provenance with dict round-trip and multi-source dataset migration.

nodes.name: validate_manifest
nodes.summary: Validates a RunManifest for required fields, supported objectives/methods (including PPO/ORPO/SimPO and OFT/QOFT), distribution constraints, and export consistency before launch.

nodes.name: ensure_within
nodes.summary: Resolves a candidate path and rejects any path that escapes the studio workspace root.

nodes.name: preflight.py
nodes.summary: Preflight inspection of datasets and models: column checks, fingerprints, approximate tokens, Hub model metadata, and atomic JSON report writing for single- and multi-source collections.

nodes.name: DatasetReport
nodes.summary: Per-source dataset inspection result with rows, columns, null counts, fingerprint, token estimate, and errors.

nodes.name: DatasetCollectionReport
nodes.summary: Aggregated multi-source dataset preflight: per-source reports, totals, combined fingerprint, and errors.

nodes.name: ModelReport
nodes.summary: Model inspection result: resolved revision, architecture, parameters, context length, gated status, license, weight size, and estimated training VRAM.

nodes.name: _required_columns
nodes.summary: Maps a DatasetSourceSpec mapping type to the set of required columns for preference, KTO, GRPO, prompt_response, or plain text.

nodes.name: inspect_dataset
nodes.summary: Samples a Hugging Face dataset, checks required columns, counts nulls, fingerprints rows, and estimates tokens for a DatasetReport.

nodes.name: inspect_model
nodes.summary: Loads Hub model_info and AutoConfig to report architecture, parameter count, gated status, and method-based VRAM estimate.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a dataset or model report dataclass as indented JSON via a temp file replace.

nodes.name: recipes.py
nodes.summary: Training recipe catalog (SFT, DPO, ORPO, SimPO, PPO, GRPO, etc.) with allowed PEFT methods, column requirements, built-in GRPO reward functions, and trusted custom reward module loading.

nodes.name: Recipe
nodes.summary: Immutable recipe entry: objective id, required columns, allowed methods, and stability status.

nodes.name: supported_methods
nodes.summary: Returns PEFT/full methods for an objective in METHOD_ORDER (qlora, lora, qoft, oft, full).

nodes.name: validate_recipe
nodes.summary: Checks that dataset columns and chosen PEFT method satisfy the recipe for a training objective.

nodes.name: exact_reward
nodes.summary: GRPO reward that scores 1.0 when completion strip-equals ground truth, else 0.0.

nodes.name: numeric_reward
nodes.summary: GRPO reward comparing the last numeric token in completion vs ground truth.

nodes.name: regex_reward
nodes.summary: GRPO reward that treats ground_truth as a regex pattern matched against each completion.

nodes.name: length_reward
nodes.summary: Default GRPO length reward scaled to 1.0 at 200 characters.

nodes.name: copy_trusted_reward
nodes.summary: Copies a user Python reward module into the job inputs dir, hashes it, and validates reward(completions, **kwargs) returns per-completion scores.

nodes.name: load_trusted_reward
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads a previously staged trusted reward module and returns its reward callable.

nodes.name: worker.py
nodes.summary: Training worker entrypoint: loads multi-source datasets, concatenates them, runs TRL trainers (SFT/DPO/ORPO/SimPO/KTO/PPO/GRPO/reward) with LoRA/OFT/QOFT/full, evaluates, exports adapters/merged models, Hub, and Ollama.
nodes.languageNotes: Objective-specific TRL trainers; multi-source datasets are inspected then concatenate_datasets before train/test split.

nodes.name: EventWriter
nodes.summary: Appends JSONL stage events under the job directory and mirrors stage/progress into the job database via update_job.

nodes.name: load_manifest
nodes.summary: Loads a job row and deserializes its manifest path into a RunManifest.

nodes.name: load_data
nodes.summary: Loads one DatasetSourceSpec from the Hub or local CSV/JSON/Parquet files and requires at least two rows.

nodes.name: render_dataset
nodes.summary: Maps a loaded dataset into recipe columns or rendered text using preference mappings, chat templates, or tokenizer.apply_chat_template.

nodes.name: prepare_datasets
nodes.summary: Loads, inspects, and renders every DatasetSpec source, writes DatasetCollectionReport, then concatenates prepared datasets for training.

nodes.name: import_into_ollama
nodes.summary: Writes a Modelfile for a merged model path and runs ollama create to import it locally.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Full job pipeline: prepare multi-source data, configure LoRA/OFT/QOFT or Unsloth, dispatch TRL trainer by objective (including PPO/ORPO/SimPO), evaluate, save artifacts, and optional Hub/Ollama export.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry for python -m fine_tuning_studio.worker JOB_ID; runs the job and records failure status on exceptions.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Streamlit multi-page UI for Fine-Tuning Studio: system diagnostics, multi-dataset and model setup, training approach/method matrix (SFT/PPO/ORPO/SimPO and LoRA/QLoRA/OFT/QOFT), job launch/monitor, export, and Ollama playground.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Streamlit app using session_state for wizard-style multi-page configuration and st.navigation for page routing.

nodes.name: initialize_state
nodes.summary: Seeds Streamlit session_state with default dataset, model, training, evaluation, and export configuration.

nodes.name: compatibility_rail
nodes.summary: Shows a caption rail of runtime readiness for the selected training method, profile path, and model settings.

nodes.name: active_worker_pids
nodes.summary: Collects PIDs of active training job workers from the job store for GPU cleanup protection.

nodes.name: stop_application_dialog
nodes.summary: UI flow that stops application-owned processes and schedules a clean Streamlit exit.

nodes.name: gpu_memory_rows
nodes.summary: Flattens a GPU memory report into table rows for Streamlit dataframe display.

nodes.name: render_gpu_cleanup
nodes.summary: Renders GPU memory inspection, reclaim, and selective process termination controls with worker-PID protection.

nodes.name: system_page
nodes.summary: System page showing machine scan, QLoRA capability, GPU cleanup, runtime profiles, provisioning, and diagnostics download.

nodes.name: preview_upload
nodes.summary: Reads an uploaded CSV, JSON, or Parquet file via PyArrow for dataset preview.

nodes.name: hub_error_message
nodes.summary: Maps Hugging Face Hub exceptions to user-facing error strings for gated, missing, or HTTP failures.

nodes.name: render_hub_download
nodes.summary: Button-driven Hub download UI that plans and fetches a repository with status feedback.

nodes.name: dataset_page
nodes.summary: Multi-dataset configuration page for Hub, upload, and local sources with column mapping and mix weights.

nodes.name: model_page
nodes.summary: Model selection page for Hub or local paths, optional gated access, Hub download, and model info preview.

nodes.name: training_page
nodes.summary: Training approach/method matrix and hyperparameter controls for SFT, preference methods (PPO/DPO/ORPO/SimPO/etc.), LoRA/QLoRA/OFT/QOFT, and runtime profile selection.

nodes.name: build_manifest
nodes.summary: Assembles a RunManifest from session_state dataset, model, training, evaluation, and export specs.

nodes.name: review_page
nodes.summary: Review-and-run page that validates the manifest, checks runtime readiness, and creates/launches training jobs.

nodes.name: monitor_page
nodes.summary: Job monitor page listing jobs with terminate, resume/launch, and log/directory access.

nodes.name: export_page
nodes.summary: Export configuration page for adapter merge, GGUF, and Ollama export options from completed jobs.

nodes.name: render_ollama_metrics
nodes.summary: Displays token and timing metrics from an Ollama generation response.

nodes.name: ollama_playground_page
nodes.summary: Interactive Ollama playground for listing models, chat/generate, and streaming responses with metrics.

nodes.name: runtimes.py
nodes.summary: Defines CPU/CUDA/ROCm/XPU runtime profiles, readiness verdicts from machine reports, smoke tests, and uv-based venv provisioning with torch and training stack packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses frozen dataclasses for immutable RuntimeProfile and RuntimeVerdict definitions.

nodes.name: RuntimeProfile
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a managed runtime profile (vendor, OS support, torch index, status, notes).

nodes.name: RuntimeVerdict
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding runtime readiness state and human-readable reasons for a profile.

nodes.name: runtime_verdict
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a profile is unsupported, install-required, or ready given OS, GPU vendor, torch availability, and QLoRA package needs.

nodes.name: smoke_test
nodes.summary: Runs a small torch matrix multiply on the profile device to verify the runtime works.

nodes.name: provision_profile
nodes.summary: Creates a uv-managed venv for a profile, installs torch from the vendor index and core fine-tuning packages, and writes profile.json.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root for Fine-Tuning Studio, declaring the public package version string.

nodes.name: jobs.py
nodes.summary: Job lifecycle service: creates runs with staged multi-file local dataset uploads, resumes non-PPO checkpoints, launches workers (including Accelerate multi-GPU), and cancels, terminates, or reconciles active training jobs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses path containment checks, SQLite job records, and platform-specific process management (CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows, process groups elsewhere).

nodes.name: studio_home
nodes.summary: Resolves and creates the studio data root from FINE_TUNING_STUDIO_HOME or ~/.fine-tuning-studio.

nodes.name: job_directory
nodes.summary: Returns a path-safe per-job directory under studio_home/jobs, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: create_job
nodes.summary: Stages multiple local dataset uploads into the job tree, optionally copies a trusted reward module, writes the run manifest, and inserts a queued SQLite job row.

nodes.name: resume_job
nodes.summary: Creates a child job from a parent checkpoint, rejecting PPO resumes and checkpoints outside the parent job directory.

nodes.name: update_job
nodes.summary: Updates allowed job columns (status, stage, progress, pid, error, exit_code) and the updated_at timestamp in SQLite.

nodes.name: get_job
nodes.summary: Fetches a single job row by id from the SQLite jobs table.

nodes.name: list_jobs
nodes.summary: Lists recent jobs ordered by created_at descending with a configurable limit.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to learn what Fine-Tuning Studio is: a local-first Streamlit app for preparing datasets, running post-training recipes, evaluating results, exporting adapters, and testing with Ollama. Version 1.1 highlights multi-dataset schema-v5 manifests and the expanded recipe matrix (PPO, ORPO, SimPO, OFT, QOFT). This document also covers install via uv, launch options, and security boundaries before you open any source.

tour.title: UI and CLI Entry Points
tour.description: After the README, the product surfaces through two packaged entry points. app.py is the multi-page Streamlit UI for system checks, multi-dataset and model setup, the training approach/method matrix, job monitoring, export, and the Ollama playground. cli.py launches that app, runs doctor checks, and manages backups, with the console script declared in pyproject.toml.
tour.languageLesson: Python packaging maps a console script in pyproject.toml [project.scripts] to a callable; the CLI can then subprocess or invoke Streamlit without hard-coding install paths.

tour.title: Domain Model and Datasets
tour.description: Building on the UI, domain.py is the shared vocabulary for every run: job status, multi-source DatasetSpec (schema v5 with independent per-source mappings), model/training/eval/export specs, RunManifest serialization, and pre-launch validation. Multi-dataset runs and constraints for PPO, ORPO, SimPO, OFT, and QOFT are encoded here so the worker and jobs layer stay consistent. docs/datasets.md explains how Hub and local sources, column maps, and global splits fit that model.

tour.title: Training Recipe Matrix
tour.description: recipes.py catalogs the training approaches—SFT, reward, DPO, KTO, ORPO, SimPO, PPO, GRPO, and related PEFT methods including LoRA, QLoRA, OFT, and QOFT—with allowed method combinations, column contracts, and trusted custom reward loading. docs/training.md walks through that matrix, default hyperparameters, evaluation, and known limits so operators understand what the domain validator will accept.

tour.title: Jobs and Local Storage
tour.description: jobs.py turns a validated RunManifest into a durable training run: staged multi-file dataset uploads, checkpoint resume (non-PPO), worker launch including Accelerate multi-GPU, and cancel/terminate/reconcile. storage.py backs that lifecycle with SQLite schema migrations, backup, restore, and integrity checks so local Studio state survives upgrades and maintenance CLI commands.

tour.title: Training Worker Pipeline
tour.description: The worker is the process jobs launch. worker.py loads multi-source datasets, concatenates them under the global split, runs TRL trainers across SFT/DPO/ORPO/SimPO/KTO/PPO/GRPO/reward with LoRA/OFT/QOFT/full, then evaluates and exports adapters or merged models to disk, Hub, or Ollama. This is where 1.1 multi-dataset concatenation and the expanded recipe matrix actually execute on your GPU.

tour.title: Runtimes and Hardware
tour.description: Before and during training, the app must know what the machine can run. runtimes.py defines CPU/CUDA/ROCm/XPU profiles, readiness verdicts, smoke tests, and uv-based venv provisioning for torch and the training stack. system_info.py detects OS, CPU, GPU, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and Ollama capabilities that feed those profiles and the System page in the UI.

tour.title: Ollama Export and Evaluation
tour.description: Post-training closes the loop with local inference and integrity. ollama.py is a small HTTP client for listing, chatting, and unloading local models; artifacts.py writes SHA-256 integrity manifests for exported job outputs; evals.py builds evaluation reports and can run isolated Inspect AI benchmarks. Together they support the export and playground flows described after the worker finishes.

tour.title: Verification Test Suite
tour.description: The Verification layer locks the architecture with pytest. test_domain.py covers multi-source DatasetSpec and recipe constraints; test_recipes.py exercises the catalog and PEFT matrix; test_jobs.py covers launch, cancel, and resume; test_app.py guards Streamlit orchestration. Reading these tests is the fastest way to see expected 1.1 behavior without running a full GPU job.
tour.languageLesson: Pytest discovers test_*.py modules and test_* functions; parametrized tests and fixtures keep domain and job scenarios isolated from real GPUs and Hub downloads.

tour.title: CI and Release Automation
tour.description: Delivery Automation validates and ships what the tests prove. ci.yml runs Windows and Linux matrices across supported Python versions, then lint, type-check, build, and dependency audit. release.yml fires on version tags to validate package version, re-run tests, build distributions, produce SBOM and checksums, attest artifacts, and draft a GitHub release—closing the path from local fine-tuning studio to published 1.1 packages.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use on triggers, jobs for parallelism, and matrix strategies to test multiple OS/Python combinations; release jobs often chain build, attestation, and draft release steps after tag push.
